title: Netease (NTES) Stake Has Increased by Overlook Holdings Ltd
text:
Netease (NTES) Stake Has Increased by Overlook Holdings Ltd Posted by Ash 21 pm
Overlook Holdings Ltd increased its stake in Netease (NTES) by 13.52% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Overlook Holdings Ltd bought 102,316 shares as the company’s stock rose 25.71% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 858,938 shares of the miscellaneous company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $195.97M, up from 756,622 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Overlook Holdings Ltd who had been investing in Netease for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $33.94 billion market cap company. The stock increased 6.61% or $16.03 during the last trading session, reaching $258.44. About 20 shares traded. NetEase, Inc. (NASDAQ:NTES) has declined 26.07% since January 10, 2018 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 26.07% the S&P500.
